title: Chapter 208 The Way Forward

Chapter 208 The Way Forward

Donghuang Taiyi's doubts were not on Zhong Yu's heart. People in the world have their own reasons for existence, and they are constantly striving for it with this belief. It is impossible to listen to other people's words and change at will. The pursuit of my life.

Now Donghuang Taiyi's doubts are normal, but if he agrees to himself and does not show any doubts, then it is worthy of his own vigilance, whether he has some other plan.

"In the endless universe, there are thousands of worlds, and each world is big or small, strong or weak. In the universe, as long as something gives birth to a true spirit and has some consciousness of its own, even if it is extremely weak, It is regarded as a group of living beings. The way of heaven, he wants to maintain the movement of heaven and earth, and the laws of all things naturally need consciousness to carry out, and naturally also have their own true spirit, which belongs to the group of living beings, and naturally cannot escape the avenue of the cycle of all things." Zhong Yu is simple. He talked about the existence of the heavens and worlds in the universe, and named the Dao of Heaven, which is just one of them, an inconspicuous member of the vast world like Hengsha.

"So, His Highness and the others came from beyond the sky and came to our world from another world. What kind of intentions do they have?" Dong Huang was already somewhat skeptical at this moment.

After all, the person in front of him, as well as the country and huge army behind him, seemed to appear suddenly, sweeping the entire northern border and the world.

If a huge empire wants to rise, it will inevitably need the accumulation of several generations and enough power to support its hegemony.

In the usual form and common sense, if a country wants to rise, it will take at least decades of accumulation, plunder to cultivate enough population, train enough troops, and train enough talents to support the hegemony of an empire.

And the rise of the Yu Kingdom was so sudden. In the northern border, within a few years, a huge empire spanning tens of thousands of miles and with millions of soldiers appeared. How can the people of the world not be surprised!

This kind of thing that goes against common sense is naturally puzzled by all the people in the world, and there are various speculations.

If the explanation given by His Royal Highness Prince Jing is true, it can solve the doubts of the people in the world, and the Eastern Emperor can also understand why he cannot see the trajectory of Prince Jing's fate from the astrology!

People who are not in this world have not been contaminated with any breath of this world since they were born, so naturally they cannot be captured by the heavenly way of this world and arrange their lives.

"You can understand it this way. Under the universe, the heavens and myriad realms are as innumerable as constant sand, and your world is just an inconspicuous existence like a grain of sand!" Chucking a few times, Zhong Yu looked Said a little arrogantly.

"Then what is the world outside the sky like?" Donghuang Taiyi seemed to have opened up another world in front of him, with a bright future ahead.

"In the endless worlds in the universe, some people have divided them according to the person with the highest combat power who can appear in their respective worlds. This is based on the basis of a world. The pressure to bear and the price to pay will be evaluated.” Speaking of the highest possible combat power, Zhong Yu couldn’t help but think of the god who appeared in this world, Nine Heavens Profound Girl.

"Just like in Jianghu, the status of each school is divided according to the top combat power of each school?" Seeing that King Jing in front of him stopped and didn't continue, Donghuang himself added.

"That's right, that's right. Some people don't have the slightest supernatural power, such as the internal power of this world. These worlds are called the world of constant sand. They are too small. Compared to the heavens and worlds, they are like small gravels in the desert." , It’s hard to detect! And some supernatural powers appeared, but they didn’t reach the transcendence and enter the sacred world. In other words, there were no gods and immortals, which are completely different from ordinary people, and they were called Xiaoqian world. !And some worlds where gods and immortals appear are called the Middle Thousand World. As for the Great Thousand World and the legendary Eternal World above it, it is not something that ants like us can evaluate now!" Said the world Level, Zhong Yu thought of his own world that was used as the residence of the Heavenly Court.

The richness of the aura in it has reached the level of Zhongqian World, but the scale and the strength of the creatures have not reached the standard.

"Then what level is our world at?" A vast worldview appeared in front of him. Donghuang Taiyi understood the division of the heavens and worlds, but he couldn't help wondering what level his world belonged to.

"It's hard to say in this world of yours. As far as I know, there have been Nine Heavens Profound Girls in this world. This kind of existence has reached the level of gods. After that, Xuanyuan and Chi You should also be strong close to gods. So logically speaking, your world should belong to the middle thousand world!" Zhong Yu frowned, and his understanding of this world was not too clear.

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, Donghuang Taiyi's face under the mask was a little surprised. If there are gods, doesn't that mean that he can also become a god?

But he didn't last long for the surprise, Zhong Yu's next words completely shattered her surprise and fantasy.

"However, the aura in your world is far from reaching the standard of the Middle Thousand World, and even in the Small Thousand World, it can only be considered top-notch, far below the top, and the trace of the Nine Heavens Profound Girl is also Completely disappeared, in my estimation, either something happened in this world and the Nine Heavens Profound Girl has fallen, or the Nine Heavens Profound Girl has broken through the realm and ascended, leaving this world completely!" In the words, Zhong Yu said own guesses about the world.

"Boundary breaking and ascension?" Donghuang didn't care about what happened to his world, but was very interested in the last mentioned world breaking and ascension, leaving the world.

"Boundary-breaking and ascension is a person's strength, which can't be accommodated by the heavens and the earth. He has forcibly broken the barrier between the heavens and the earth, left this small world, and went to another bigger world to carry out his broader mission. The future of cultivation!" Seemingly seeing Donghuang's curiosity, Zhong Yu explained to him without embarrassing him.

"Extremely strong strength, how much strength is needed to break through the boundary and ascend?" Donghuang asked quickly as if he had found another way to pursue the way of heaven.

"You, don't think about it. People who can break through the world and ascend are all brilliant and lucky people. They even have the approval of heaven and humanity to a certain extent before they can break through the world." Feisheng, from the perspective of your luck and your lifelong achievement aptitude, if you want to break through the boundary and ascend, it may be just in case!" Zhong Yu hit Donghuang mercilessly.
